name: PC Control
description: Allows AI to execute terminal commands and open applications.
allow_exec: Allow AI to execute shell commands
sys_prompt_intro: You are running on a {os_name} system. You have access to the terminal.
sys_prompt_exec: To execute a command, output EXACTLY this tag on a new line: [[EXEC: your_command_here]]
sys_prompt_no_backticks: Do not wrap the command in backticks or quotes inside the [[EXEC:]] tag.
sys_prompt_custom: You also have these predefined commands:
sys_prompt_custom_use: To use a predefined command, just output its EXEC tag like any other command.
